description: This bundle includes Trumiri incense holder and Hem 5-in-1 Feng Shui 20g Incense Sticks. Our incense sticks and cones are hand made in India according to ancient traditions with natural and pure ingredients such as sandalwood powder, honey, wood gums, herbs, flowers and essential oils. Our products are famous for their superior performance and fine quality. Incense sticks and cones typically complement aromatherapy, yoga, romance, soothing, prayer and meditation. Our incenses are available in different fragrances such as Rose, Lavender, Cinnamon, Dragon's Blood, Palo Santo, Vanilla, Jasmine, Sandalwood, White Sage, Nagchampa, Coconut etc. Please visit our other listings to get to know all of our unique fragrances. Please store the incenses in a cool dry place preferably in its original sealed packaging or in an air-tight container.
